rule: Required crude production per OPEC+ country from public OPEC+ decisions. A decision is used for compliance only when VERIFIED against the cited statement (figure_text, urls, checked_at); a VERIFY decision is UNMEASURED. A country absent from the decision's table is listed under exempt with required null. Compliance is computed only against a production estimate on this host; without one it is UNMEASURED.

verification.page_or_table: statement annex, 'Country Required Production Level for 2025'
verification.provenance: the table was read from a third-party mirror (poder360) of the statement as printed from the Saudi Ministry of Energy portal; OPEC's own table PDF (https://www.opec.org/assets/assetdb/production-table-37th-onomm.pdf) returned a fetch error. OPEC's own release page (12-02-jun-2024) was read and confirms the meeting and 'as per the attached table starting 1 January 2025 until 31 December 2025'; the 38th ONOMM release (28-05-dec-2024) reads 'Extend the level of overall crude oil production ... as per the attached table until 31 December 2026', which is the basis of effective_to
verification.cross_check: OPEC rows sum to 24,135 and non-OPEC rows to 15,590, matching the printed totals
verification.read_via: WebFetch server-side fetch (this container's proxy refuses the host); text extracted from the PDF/page and the figure quoted from that extraction
